hypotheses.claim: The only current Owner qualification that binds the attachment is tied to the old r2 scene and requires the original baseline identities and bytes.
hypotheses.falsifier: A separate authorized Owner admission with its own D pin and ordinary token exists and does not require the r2 source, profile roots or coordination objects.

hypotheses.claim: The production Status serializer projects the actual two-record attachment result with distinct Start and attachment errors and no recovery authority.
hypotheses.falsifier: A native collision or injected write failure is durable, the Start error is overwritten, or the projection is visible in Running or LostWorkerUnknown.
hypotheses.method: Feed actual storage results into controller-owned synthetic WorkerControl state, then call the unchanged observe implementation.

hypotheses.claim: The retained Source, when present, requires three full scans around the two preparation-reference reads, within one original recovery deadline.
hypotheses.falsifier: An extra complete scan is reached from this path or the action resets its absolute deadline between boundaries.
hypotheses.method: Trace the exact conditional call sequence and compare with the existing fixed-copy and Journal measurements.
